title: aidd metrics --json
description: What `aidd metrics --json` prints: an object carrying `schema_version` for each view. The summary, `--by` (the summaries by group), `--dora` and `--autonomy` (their rows), `--guard`, `--flaky`, `--autonomy --suggest-standard-changes`, `--autopilot`, and `--roles`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

changes.description: The distinct changes (pull or merge requests) the events are about.

final_decisions.description: Changes by the decision of their last event.

routes.description: Changes by the route of their last event.

first_pass_tests_rate.description: Share of heads whose tests passed on the first evaluation that saw them.

route_corrections.description: Changes the gate failed at least once because the declared route was below the computed one.

top_failed_rules.description: Up to eight [rule, count] pairs, most frequent first.

median_changed_lines.description: The median changed lines of each change's last event; null with no change.

ai_assisted_share.description: The share of changes whose last event names an agent in `assisted_by`, from 0 to 1; null with no change.

raised_to_major.description: Changes the gate raised to major from the route the author declared (their last event carries `declared_route`).

emergency_rate.description: The share of changes whose last decision was on the emergency route; null with no changes.

flaky_runs.description: Green test results that passed only on a retry (``tests` retries`): the gate counted them green.

median_wait_minutes.description: Median minutes each pending rule (approval or check) held a change, by rule id.

wait_above_target.description: The rules whose median wait is above --target-wait.

median_hours_to_pass.description: The median hours from a change's first event to its first passing one; null when none passed.

median_hours_to_first_approval.description: The median hours from a change's first event to the first one that counts an approval; null with none.

first_pass_share.description: Share of passed changes that passed on the first head the tests ran on.

spec_reworked_after_spec_approval.description: Changes whose Spec hash changed after Spec approval held.

plan_adherence_share.description: Of the changes whose last event names a Spec, the share with no Task that changed nothing in its scope; null with none.

open_waiting.description: Changes whose last decision is pending: the human queue.

open_waiting_by_rule.description: Those waiting changes, counted by each rule they wait on.

throughput_per_week.description: Passing changes per week over the span of the events (at least one day); null with no event time.

advisory_would_block_share.description: Of the changes whose last event ran in advisory mode, the share the gate would have failed; null with none.

first_feedback_minutes.description: Minutes from a head's push to the first gate decision holding its test results.

flow_efficiency.description: Active minutes over lead minutes, over the changes that passed.

spec_rework_rate.description: Share of approved Specs reworked after Spec approval.

fast_major_merge_approvals.description: The rubber-stamp indicator: of the major changes whose Merge approval wait ended, how many ended within `within_minutes` of the gate first asking for it, and which (at most 20). A signal for a retrospective, never a gate rule; null when no major change's wait ended in the events.

within_minutes.description: The threshold: a Merge approval wait shorter than this many minutes counts as fast.

count.description: Major changes whose last Merge approval wait was shorter than the threshold.

of.description: Major changes with a measured Merge approval wait.

changes.description: The fast ones' change ids, sorted, at most 20.

loop_speed.description: Each loop-speed metric, judged against its `targets` key and paired with a quality measure.

suite_runs.description: Duplicate work: the `aidd test` runs this machine recorded (`test` lines in .git/aidd/events.jsonl), per head. A full run is one that ran red on base and was not partial; one per head and independent reader is the aim. Null when no test line is read.

heads.description: The heads with at least one recorded run.

full_runs.description: Runs that ran red on base and were not partial.

per_head.description: Full runs per head: the median, the 90th percentile, and the heads counted.

handoffs.description: Broken handoffs, with --specs: the handoff notes in the Specs, and those a reader cannot use (not YAML, a missing key, a `next` that is no role, or an unknown status; `aidd validate` names each).

notes.description: Every handoff note in the Specs.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

groups.description: Each group's summary, by the group's name.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

by_reason.description: Denials by reason code, most first.

by_role.description: Denials by aidd-team role, most first; `session` when no role was active.

by_tool.description: Denials by the tool the agent called, most first.

flaky.description: `aidd metrics --flaky --json`: per test command, how often it passed on a re-run after failing on the same head, worst first.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

limit.description: The share of heads above which a test is over the limit: fix it or quarantine it.

tests.description: One row per test command, worst first: by rate, then by count, then by name.

heads.description: The heads it ran on. A head counts once, however many gate events judged it.

passed_on_rerun.description: The heads where it passed on a re-run after failing: the runner's retry, or a later gate event on the same head.

over_limit.description: True when the rate is over `limit`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

proposals.description: One `standard_changes` entry to start from per agent and change type at the candidate-standard-change stage. A person completes and merges it; it is never applied.

type.description: The change type, such as `deps` or `docs`.

evidence.description: The counts that put the agent at that stage for this type.

changes.description: Changes the agent made of this type.

passed.description: Of those, the ones that passed.

first_pass_share.description: Of the passed ones, the share that passed on the first head the tests ran on.

failed.description: Changes whose last decision was fail.

reworked.description: Changes whose Spec changed after Spec approval.

yaml.description: A `standard_changes` entry, as YAML, for a person to fill and merge into the config.

metric.description: The metric's key, and its `targets` key.

value.description: The measured value; null when the events cannot measure it.

target.description: The `targets` value for this metric; null when none is set.

met.description: Null when there is no value or no target.

better.description: Which direction is better, which decides whether the target is met.

measures.description: What aidd actually measures, said plainly.

type.description: The change type; `unknown` when the event has none.

changes.description: Changes the agent made of this type.

passed.description: Of those, the ones that passed.

first_pass.description: Of the passed ones, those that passed on the first head the tests ran on.

failed.description: Changes whose last decision was fail.

reworked.description: Changes whose Spec changed after Spec approval.

stage.description: The autonomy stage the evidence supports, for a person to act on: a suggestion, never a setting.

metric.description: The metric's key, and its `targets` key.

value.description: The measured value; null when the events cannot measure it.

target.description: The `targets` value for this metric; null when none is set.

met.description: Null when there is no value or no target.

better.description: Which direction is better, which decides whether the target is met.

measures.description: What aidd actually measures, said plainly.

metric.description: The quality metric's key in the summary.

value.description: Its value; null when the events cannot measure it.

paired.description: The quality metric shown beside a speed or cost metric, so neither improves by degrading the other.

spread.description: The median, the nearest-rank 90th percentile, and the number of samples; null with no sample.

approval_wait.description: Per approval (Spec approval, Merge approval, specialist approval), by rule id: minutes it stayed pending.

name.description: The approval's name for people, such as Merge approval.

p90.description: The nearest-rank 90th percentile wait, in minutes.

cost.description: Cost per change from a host-exported cost log (`--cost`). Display only: never a gate rule, never pauses work, never sets the exit code.

entries.description: Lines read from the cost log.

joined_by.description: Cost log entries by how they joined a change: spec, sha, branch, or none.

total.description: The total cost attributed to changes, in this currency.

changes.description: Changes with a cost in this currency.

per_change.description: The mean cost per change, in this currency.

median_per_change.description: The median cost per change, in this currency.

unattributed.description: Cost of entries that joined no change, per currency.

by_agent.description: Cost per agent (the cost log's `agent`), per currency.

met.description: Whether no change costs more than `targets.max_cost_per_change` in its currency; null when none is set.

amount.description: The most one change should cost.

currency.description: The cap's currency; only entries in it count toward the cap.

cap.description: `targets.max_cost_per_change` from the config; null when none is set.

amount.description: Its cost in the cap's currency.

over_cap.description: Each change whose cost in the cap's currency is over the cap: a warning, never the exit code.

display_only.description: Always true: cost never affects aidd/gate, never pauses work, and never sets the exit code.

runs.description: `aidd metrics --autopilot`: the autopilot runs' measures, from the run events and the guard's log.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

changes.description: The changes the runs worked on: the Spec a line names, else the run's work.

human_decisions.description: The times a run waited on a person, or was blocked until one acted.

human_decisions_per_change.description: Human decisions divided by changes; null with no change.

decision_wait_minutes.description: From each decision to the next event of its change: how long humans kept the run waiting.

agent_steps_per_decision.description: Agent steps divided by human decisions; null with no decision.

rework.description: Steps that returned a change to Implement (`spec.rework`).

cost_per_change.description: The mean recorded cost per change that has one, by currency; empty when no note records a cost.

guard_denials_during_runs.description: The guard's denials whose time falls inside a run's first and last event.

stops.description: How the runs ended, by reason.

dora.description: `aidd metrics --dora --json`: the five DORA software delivery metrics against the `targets`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

autonomy.description: `aidd metrics --autonomy --json`: per agent and change type, how its changes fared and the stage of autonomy the evidence supports.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

rows.description: One row per agent and change type.

roles.description: `aidd metrics --roles --json`: one row per aidd-team role, from the gate events, the Specs, the guard's log, the trunk's reverts, and a role eval record file; never the autopilot journal or a handoff note. Display only: never put a role's number into its prompt.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

min_changes.description: Under this many changes, a row is too few to judge.

rows.description: One row per role, in schemas/roles.json order.

reverts.description: The revert commits on the trunk ("This reverts commit <sha>").

unjoined_reverts.description: Of those, the ones that joined no Spec.

display_only.description: Always true: the rows decide no gate and never set the exit code.

role.description: The aidd-team role, as schemas/roles.json names it.

changes.description: n: the changes whose Spec has a Task with `assignee: agent:<role>`. Each such role counts the change in full.

specs.description: The Specs with a Task for the role.

first_pass_share.description: Of the role's changes that passed, the share that passed on the first head the tests ran on; null with none passed.

failing_heads_per_change.description: The heads whose tests failed, per change of the role; null with no change.

tasks_out_of_retries.description: The role's own Tasks that used their retries (`retry_count` 3).

revisions.description: The reopenings (`revisions`) of the role's Specs after Spec approval.

rolled_back.description: The role's Specs whose outcome was a rollback or a failed observe window.

reverts.description: The trunk's revert commits joined to the role's Specs.

guard_denials.description: The guard's denials of the role, from guard.jsonl.

eval.description: The role's latest fresh role eval (`aidd eval roles --record`), or null with none: a stale run never counts.

pass_at_1.description: The mean pass@1 of the role's scenarios in that run.

lift.description: The mean pass@1 over the control run's, for the role's scenarios; null when `--without-aidd` was not given.

model.description: The model the run recorded (--model-label), or null.

scenarios.description: The role's scenarios in that run.

too_few_to_judge.description: True under `min_changes` changes: read the row as too few to judge.
